title: Analyse weight-length relationship — len_weight
text: Function running log-linear regression model analyse body mass function length. Essentially just wrapper lm() predict.lm() tabulates useful summary statistics. Also returns predicted mean, 95 percent confidence intervals prediction intervals, corrected bias due log transformation, fitted lm() objects.

title: Analyse weight-length relationship — len_weight
